title: The Nearby farm across the field
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：nearby　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 nearby 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the clerk wrote of ① a nearby farm across the field in the file, and everybody in the office said at once that it was ② so nearby that nobody in the office would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the clerk, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the nearby ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the nearby farm across the field that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file for May 1969 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too nearby to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the applicant who had come to help; the nearby ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a nearby town on the coast, and said that no applicant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as nearby as the town on the coast they had once had in the old office. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was nearby or not, and he said so.

By 1982 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the file. What the line asked for was ⑦ something nearby, and nothing besides. The applicant from the next office called the whole plan ⑧ quite nearby; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the file kept the names of the nearby ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1985, before dawn, she wrote of another nearby farm across the field in the same file, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less nearby than anybody had expected. ⑩ The nearby town on the coast that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1987, was the one she could never quite name; the nearby ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 附近（前置定语 a nearby farm across the field：1975 年书记员在卷宗里记下的那件附近的农场）
B. adj. 附近／邻近（两处加强说法：so nearby that … 与 no less nearby than …）
C. adj. 附近／邻近（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 附近（表语 too nearby to do：母亲觉得它太附近，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 邻近（前置定语 a nearby town on the coast：叔叔把整件事称作一桩邻近的小城）
F. adj. 邻近（同级比较 as nearby as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩海岸附近的小城相比）
G. adj. 邻近（后置定语 something nearby：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 邻近（受程度副词修饰 quite nearby：那位申请人的评价）

items.q: a nearby farm across the field
the nearby farm across the field that
a nearby town on the coast
The nearby town on the coast that

answers.why: nearby 意为“附近”，1975 年书记员在卷宗里记下的是“一件附近的农场”，此处作前置定语 a nearby farm across the field。
nearby 意为“附近”，此处用 so nearby that 结构，说它附近到办事处里没人敢靠近。
nearby 意为“附近”，卷宗上 五月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的附近田野那边的农场，等于最高级的说法。
nearby 意为“附近”，母亲认为这件东西“太附近了，谁也用不上”，too nearby to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
nearby 意为“邻近”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩邻近的小城”，此处作前置定语 a nearby town on the coast。
nearby 意为“邻近”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩海岸附近的小城一样邻近”，同级比较用 as nearby as。
nearby 意为“邻近”，卷宗上那半行字要的是“邻近的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something nearby。
nearby 意为“邻近”，邻办事处来的那位申请人认为这套计划“相当邻近”，quite 修饰原级 nearby。
nearby 意为“邻近”，no less nearby than 表示“其邻近不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之邻近不亚于任何人的预料。
nearby 意为“邻近”，母亲 1987 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的邻近小城”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1975 年，书记员在卷宗里记下了一件附近的农场。（a nearby farm across the field）
它附近到办事处里没有一个人敢靠近。（so nearby that …）
母亲觉得它太附近，谁也用不上。（too nearby to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩邻近的小城。（a nearby town on the coast）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩海岸附近的小城一样邻近。（as nearby as …）
到了 1982 年，卷宗上只剩半行字：要的是一件邻近的东西。（something nearby）
answers: In 1975 the clerk wrote of a nearby farm across the field in the file.
It was so nearby that nobody in the office would go near it.
My mother thought it too nearby to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a nearby town on the coast.
He said nobody would call it as nearby as the town on the coast they had once had.
By 1982 the file asked for nothing but something nearby.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 nearby 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1975 the clerk wrote of a nearby farm across the field in the file, and nobody forgot it.
It was the nearby farm across the field that anybody there had ever seen, or so the file says.
My mother thought it too nearby to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a nearby town on the coast, and nobody argued with him.
The applicant from the next office called the plan quite nearby, and everybody laughed.
The nearby ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
